_doc: 27 §1 — the German half of the name filter. 16 D20 forbids machine translation, and this list obeys it in the strongest sense available: it is NOT a translation of en.json at all. German profanity does not map word-for-word onto English profanity, and a list produced by translating one would be both wrong and useless — 'hurensohn', 'kanake', 'spast' and 'missgeburt' have no counterpart in the English seed, and the English seed's 'twat' and 'wanker' have no idiomatic German entry here. A SEED on the same terms as en.json, with M17 owning the curated list. SPELLING: every term is written in its ss-expanded, diacritic-free form ('scheisse', never 'scheiße'), because that is the form the normaliser produces — it expands ss for ss and strips the umlaut marks before it matches, so a term spelled with either would be dead text. KNOWN GAP FOR THE CURATOR: same as en.json's -- a stretched spelling of a term that doubles a letter is not caught, which here affects 'missgeburt', 'nutte' and 'scheisse'.
